notes: The page lists the finalist announcement as Feb 26, 2026, which looks like a typo for 2027. No entry fee is listed.
name: Young Playwrights Festival (Wharton Center)
org: Wharton Center for Performing Arts, Michigan State University
what_you_do: Write an original one-act play of up to 12 pages. Six finalists get a staged production of their play at the Wharton Center and a cash award.
who_can_apply: Michigan high school students in grades 9 to 12.
pay_detail: Each of the six finalists receives $200.
duration: Festival performance Saturday, May 15, 2027, 2 PM, Pasant Theatre (free, public)
how_to_apply: Email your script with the form to laurie.briseno@whartoncenter.com. Use a Word file with numbered pages and no student names. The form needs a signature from a parent or guardian, a teacher who backs you, and you. Plays have no more than 4 characters.
